errors.unreachable: Cannot reach the API — is the Spring app running on port 8080?

welcome.heading: Welcome
welcome.intro: A shared list of places worth visiting. Everything here is served by the spring-reactive backend, and new destinations arrive over a WebSocket the moment anyone adds one.

cards.wishlist: Browse the shared list, add places, and remove ones you've been to.
cards.explore: Search the world's cities and add the good ones to the list.
cards.weather: Current conditions for any city, geocoded on the way through.
cards.countries: Flag, capital, region, and population for any country.
cards.iss: Watch the International Space Station move across the map.
cards.live: The raw WebSocket feed, exactly as the backend pushes it.

wishlist.heading: Wishlist
wishlist.intro: Every place on the shared list. Additions and removals from other browsers show up here without a refresh.
wishlist.mapCaption: {count} destinations plotted on an equirectangular projection.
wishlist.emptyBody: Search for a city and add the first destination.
wishlist.yourNameHint: Optional. Shown next to the places you add.

explore.heading: Explore
explore.intro: City search geocodes your query and then looks up the country, chaining two external APIs into one response.
explore.noResultsBody: Try a different spelling, or drop any country suffix.

weather.heading: Weather
weather.intro: Current conditions for any city. The backend geocodes the name first, then fetches the forecast for those coordinates.
weather.chainNote: Two sequential Open-Meteo calls: geocoding, then forecast.

countries.heading: Countries
countries.intro: Look up a country by name. This endpoint passes the REST Countries payload straight through, so the shape differs from the country data attached to destinations.
countries.nameHint: Common name, e.g. Japan or Portugal.
countries.passthroughNote: Served by GET /api/countries/{name} — raw CountryApiResult, not CountryResponse.

iss.heading: ISS Tracker
iss.intro: The backend polls Open Notify every five seconds and pushes each position down the same WebSocket that carries destination events.
iss.mapLabel: World map with the current ISS position and its recent trail
iss.pushNote: Positions arrive every 5 seconds while the socket is open.

live.heading: Live Feed
live.intro: Every frame received on /ws/destinations, newest first.
live.mergeNote: The socket merges two unrelated streams with no envelope, so the client tells them apart by the presence of an "action" field.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.intro: Client-side preferences and the backend this app is talking to.
settings.identityNote: There is no auth on the backend — addedBy is a free-text field, so this is just a name stored in your browser.
settings.sameOrigin: (same origin — proxied by Vite in dev)
settings.overrideActive: Pointing at a backend supplied via ?api= rather than the build config.
settings.overrideHint: Append ?api=http://host:8080 to the URL to point this app at another backend without rebuilding.
